sub_locations.name: Selchoun's Sundries Shop
sub_locations.description: Selchoun's Sundries Shop was a prosperous general store. The proprietor, [[Osbrin Selchoun]], sold tourist trinkets and mundane useful items.

sub_locations.name: Halazar's Fine Gems
sub_locations.description: Halazar's Fine Gems was a jewelry shop. The finest gems could be found in the shop, expertly cut and presented in simple glass cases.

sub_locations.name: Nestaur's Ropes
sub_locations.description: Nestaur's Ropes sold gear for [[adventurer]]s, primarily specializing in [[rope]]s.

sub_locations.name: Torpus's Tannery
sub_locations.description: Torpus's Tannery was a tannery owned by [[Torpus the Tanner]].

sub_locations.name: Telethar Leatherworks
sub_locations.description: Telethar Leatherworks was a leather goods store owned and operated by [[Orgul Telethar]].

sub_locations.name: Fellowship Warehouse
sub_locations.description: The Fellowship Warehouse, also known as the Fish Warehouse, was a warehouse that was owned by the [[Fishmongers' Fellowship]].

sub_locations.name: Gelfuril the Trader
sub_locations.description: Gelfuril the Trader was an unusual shop that was owned by the merchant [[Gelfuril]] in the 14th century DR. It was a similar to a pawnshop, though its owner was adamant about it not being one.

sub_locations.name: Orm's Highbench
sub_locations.description: Orm's Highbench was the headquarters of a trading company.

sub_locations.name: Bellister's House
sub_locations.description: Bellister's House was a storage warehouse that was privately owned by the business [[Bellister's Hand]] in the mid–14th century DR.

sub_locations.name: Athal's Stables
sub_locations.description: Athal's Stables were a stables. [[Mount]]s and gear related to them, such as [[bit and bridle|bits, bridles]], and [[saddle]]s, could be purchased here.

sub_locations.name: Bellister's Hand
sub_locations.description: Bellister's Hand was a store. This business sold general goods. It was also possible to find stolen goods here.

sub_locations.name: Melgard's Fine Leathers

sub_locations.name: Thomm Warehouse

sub_locations.name: Pelauvir's Counter

sub_locations.name: Turnstone Plumbing and Pipefitting

sub_locations.name: Serpentil Books & Folios

The store also sold thin, waxed climbing cables that were popular among [[thieves]].
